rules.note: Not listed in the official requirements.
Photo attached to the application form: 4.5 x 3.5 cm, taken within 6 months, upper body, full face, no hat. Write your name and nationality on the back.

Certificate of graduation or degree certificate (graduate-school degree: both undergraduate and graduate). Not yet graduated: certificate of prospective graduation. A copy attested by the university is accepted.

Transcript for all years of university attended (graduate degree: undergraduate and graduate), showing the grade scale and grades. A degree certificate does not replace it. Japanese or English, or add a translation.
The 2027 "Field of Study and Research Plan" form: your past and present field of study and your research theme and plan in Japan. It is used to place you at a university.
Letter from the president, dean or academic advisor of the university you attend or last attended. Any format is accepted.
The 2027 Certificate of Health form, filled in and signed by a medical doctor.
Abstracts of your theses (graduation thesis and presented papers are fine), if you have written any. Put your name on the first page.
Only if you have a Japanese or English certificate showing your name and level or score, issued within the last 2 years. Submit copies.
Only if you are currently employed: recommendation letter from your present employer. Any format is accepted.
Only if you will major in fine arts or music: photographs of your own works or a recording of a musical performance.
The 2027 Placement Preference Application Form (university placement preferences), submitted with the other forms to the Japanese embassy or consulate in your country.
